alphaMethod: Arithmetic mean of the three expanding-window training-fold dispersion estimates; same feature-model mean is used for Poisson and NB2, matching the paired validation design.
notes: Distribution selection is line-specific and based on Holm-adjusted paired walk-forward tests.
For lines without a statistically clear NB2 advantage, Poisson is retained as the simpler distribution.
NB2 dispersion alpha is the arithmetic mean of the three training-fold estimates; it is a fixed v1 deployment approximation, not a newly fitted full-sample alpha.
Research validation is not an ROI or profitability test.
